test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Polished
solution:
The correct answer is- "Cultured".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Cultured"** is the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
 
• We use the word -**"Polished"** for a person with a polished personality is generally considered to be smart, self-assured, and graceful.
 
 
• **Example:** Ram's selection was already confirmed as his** polished **skills makes him stand in elites.
 
 
 
• Thus, **option 4)** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Paramount: **Most important

 
 
• **Example: **Trust and dignity are the **paramount** of this institution.
 
 
 
• **Crude: **Raw/ without refinement
 
 
• **Example: **The prices of **crude **oils are increasing day by day.
